findings.title: Ingress TLS Secret is missing or has no certificate
findings.cause: Ingress web serves TLS for shop.example.com from Secret shop-tls, which does not exist in namespace kd-ingress-tls-secret-missing, so the controller serves its default certificate and clients reject it

evidence.what: Ingress web serves TLS for shop.example.com from Secret shop-tls
evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-tls-secret-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.tls}'

evidence.what: there is no Secret shop-tls in namespace kd-ingress-tls-secret-missing

findings.fix: Create the TLS Secret shop-tls in namespace kd-ingress-tls-secret-missing (kubectl create secret tls, or a cert-manager Certificate), or correct secretName.
